messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Software and Device Operations" as it appears in the following examples.
['Due to this upgrade we urge you to please upgrade to this service now for security purpose.', 'As a result of this you may experience service problems, if you do not upgrade.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Simply download Skype - it’s totally free - and you can make and receive free video and voice calls to and from anyone else with Skype.', 'Our Technical Department is running a planned Personal and Commercial Banking software upgrade.', 'CLICK HERE to upgrade your online banking.', 'To read the encrypted message, complete the following steps: - Double-click the encrypted message file attachment to download the file to your computer.', 'UPGRADE NOW TO THE NEWEST VERSION', 'Update your system through this official site if your account has been created before October 22, 2008.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
